label: Double Reverse Pleats
description: Double reverse pleats use two outward-facing folds per side, giving the fullest, roomiest front and a relaxed, voluminous drape through the hip and thigh. The outward direction emphasises width, making this a bold, classic choice on wide and high-rise trousers. It is the most generous pleat configuration in common use.
